unreported_quarters.2018Q4: Ownership change Tesaro to GSK plc; no full-quarter figure is published. Tesaro was acquired by GSK on 22 Jan 2019 and did not publish Q4 2018 / FY2018 results (no 10-K or earnings 8-K in its filing list); later quarters are GSK-booked in gsk_zejula. Zejula launched in the U.S. in April 2017 (Tesaro, Inc.; Tesaro 8-K 0001104659-17-050247 EX-99.1). GSK first booked Zejula after acquiring Tesaro on 22 Jan 2019, so the GSK worldwide series starts 2019Q1. Tesaro-booked quarters 2017Q2-2018Q3 are delivered separately as gsk_zejula_alt. Q4 2018 is not citable from either issuer: the Tesaro filing list (data.sec.gov, CIK 0001491576) has no 10-K for FY2018 and no earnings 8-K after 2018-11-01 (the later 8-Ks of 2018-12-03, 2018-12-04, 2019-01-22 and 2019-01-24 were opened and are merger-related, with no product revenue table), and GSK did not own Tesaro in Q4 2018, so the two pieces cannot be joined.
